instructions: X, Y, M, and N are anonymous implementation labels only.
Do not search for experiment names, branch names, prior evaluations, publication materials, or treatment mappings.
Code each implementation independently before comparing it with its peer.
Choose only from the declared category and confidence options.
Complete the companion evidence worksheet separately using the same study/arm/dimension join key.
If treatment mapping or prior ratings become known, report the exposure and stop.

categoryDefinitions.definition: One implementation or shared rule serves every item that needs the concern, with one invariant/behavior for reachable equivalent inputs.
More than one implementation or representation exists, but no reachable equivalent input is shown to produce contradictory behavior or invariants.
The same concern is derived or enforced differently and concrete code evidence shows different behavior or invariants for reachable equivalent inputs.
The concern is required by the supplied task/specification but is absent where required.
The supplied anonymous material is insufficient for a defensible category judgment.
